# Current State

## Objective

Deliver a credible, tested ArifCE V0.1 without overstating incomplete scope.

## Status

TASK-0001 is open. The product contract, .NET 10 solution, canonical store, journal, FTS index, core CLI flows, claims/evidence, handoff, refactor guard evaluation, agent adapters, redaction, doctor command, and behavior tests are implemented.

## Blockers

Public release is blocked by license selection, full cross-platform CI, package/install verification, richer refactor authoring, structured test/build evidence parsing, and the complete end-to-end release fixture.

## Next steps

Rebuild and rerun all tests after the final context/refactor changes. Add structured evidence parsers and complete the release checklist. Ask the owner to select MIT or Apache-2.0 before public release.
